stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
technicalNotes:
When found in VW Golf (1K) or similar:
Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s) in Dash Board and Electronic Box (Engine Compartment)
Kontrol edin:  bolted Power Connections in Electronic Box (Engine Compartment)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Central Electronics Control Module
Kontrol edin:  Power Supply Relais for Terminal 30 (J317)
